description: Approved plan steps2-6 after canonical identity .27.10. Extend shared discovery to From/To/CC, persist participant Person refs, replicated histories thread-scoped using normalized root refs independent sender, explicit reply-all To/Cc respecting Reply-To/self exclusion and selected SMTP, receipt actual audience through single HistoryIngress owner. Titles email Sender Person: trimmed subject; Telegram DM peer Person, connector beneath. Regression first; existing components/actions reused. No WIP historical repair. Fresh isolated DB migration+q+affected tests; feature E2E waits separate UX approval. No commit/push.

comments.text: Implemented and validated, uncommitted. Author and visible recipient discovery reuse People.find_or_create_from_channel; canonical history_context stores Person refs/roles and presentation hints. Replicated copies use normalized RFC conversation identity independently of sender/delivery route. ReplyTargets preserves explicit To/CC through Incoming/Outgoing; Reply-To/From, deduplication, configured self-address exclusion and selected SMTP are exercised through real Swoosh delivery. Actual envelope receipt uses existing HistoryIngress fixed-target/ID-only owner; admission/finalization preserves canonical input and assistant UUIDs. Email Sender Person: subject and Telegram Direct Person titles use existing BO layout with connector underneath. Targeted 105 tests+5 properties passed, then final mix q and precommit passed:17 doctests,159 properties,9089 tests,0 failures,1 skipped,93 excluded. Fresh migration chain passed on _identity_fresh after extensions setup. E2E not authored; separate human UX approval, review/coverage and outcome acceptance remain open. Action evidence: extend EnsurePerson/shared People discovery and existing SMTP/history owners; local-only normalization structs, no new exposed agent tool.

Approved alias/loop fix in progress. Reproduced parser failures first. Action reuse assessment: extend existing Parser ReplyTargets normalization (local-only transport evidence; first Delivered-To exclusion, never permissions or inferred sender); reuse SMTP sender filtering and receipt operation, HistoryIngress source identity/confirmation lookup, Engine.Api/NodeRouter dispatch and CommunicationBridge passive capture. New confirmed_history_delivery event is an internal read of the existing durable owner, no parallel registry or agent tool. Automatic replies marked auto-replied; exact scoped confirmed echoes skipped, other auto-replies captured passively. Added real SMTP path, pre-confirmation, human sender, source/connector scope, empty-recipient and property regressions. Initial q found test alias style issue, corrected; validation underway.

Alias/loop follow-up implemented and issue-validated, uncommitted. First Delivered-To is message-local receiving evidence; excludes alias in To/Cc without granting hidden history. Removed inferred sender fallback to Delivered-To/To; configured login or SMTP settings select sender. Replies retain selected SMTP and actual recipient receipt; sender module is loaded before receipt capability check. Auto-Submitted auto-replied suppresses generation before confirmation; exact confirmed source/provider/connector/Message-ID echoes skip capture and generation even without header. Tests exercise real SMTP, separate login/sender/alias, Reply-To, empty recipients without fallback, early/confirmed echoes, legitimate human sender, connector/source mismatches, folded/forwarded/malformed headers and recipient property invariants. Final affected suite: 367 tests + 9 properties, 0 failures; mix q and git diff --check passed. docs/services/channels.md and existing handoff updated. Final PR A UX approval/E2E/review/coverage/precommit remain pending; this is not outcome acceptance.

User reported sender regression after alias loop fix; approved restoring receiving alias as reply From. Reproduced first: parser and two real SMTP-path tests failed because From was login/main account, including exact zaq-local@eweev.com -> julien@fayad.fr + Cc j.tarabay@zaq.ai case. Action reuse: extend existing Parser reply_from precedence only; reuse existing EmailBridge/SmtpSender transport, connector selection, recipient filtering, receipts and loop guards. Local-only normalization, no new Action/tool/operation. Receiving alias now precedes configured mailbox; recipient exclusions independently retain mailbox + alias. Corrected incorrect previous test expectations; validation in progress.
